messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert for maya (oncall) - P0 - Canary rollout failing: multiple pods reporting KMS Decrypt errors during feature-flagger startup. Please acknowledge.

maya (oncall): ack. pulling up canary deploy and logs now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout of release d3f456 applied to service ff-bridge in us-east-1 at 2026-03-15T14:22:10Z. Canary fraction: 15% (15 pods).

leah (eng-runtime): errors across several canary pods: `kms:Decrypt` failing with AccessDenied. example log:
```
2026-03-15T14:23:05Z ERROR kms_client.go:87 decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/canary-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/9a8b7c6d
```

olga (infra): interestingly, that key id `9a8b7c6d` is the *rotated* key we activated last night during maintenance. I pushed rotation and added grants to the standard service roles, but I might have missed the ephemeral `canary-role` we create per-deploy.

ryo (eng-sre): Confirming: IAM principal for canary pods uses `assumed-role/canary-role@projects`. The grant list on the new key only includes `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ff-service` and `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-deploy`, not the ephemeral canary role. That would explain AccessDenied.

maya (oncall): So root cause is key rotation + missing grant for canary role. What are the mitigation options?

leah (eng-runtime): Options: 1) Add grant to the new KMS key for the canary role (fast, but infra runbook required), 2) rollback canary to previous release (safe), 3) set the feature flag global kill to prevent evaluation while we fix. Which is fastest?

olga (infra): I can create the grant quickly if we agree. Command (AWS CLI):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id 9a8b7c6d --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/canary-role --operations Decrypt --name "canary-grant-2026-03-15"
```
I will create the grant and confirm.

ryo (eng-sre): Before granting, note that canary role is ephemeral and re-created each deploy, but our deploy system includes an instance profile alias `role/canary-role` stable ARN so grant should stick. Also we need to ensure grants are tracked in infra config.

leah (eng-runtime): meanwhile, I'm going to set a temporary global override for feature evaluation to avoid customer-visible toggles: `ffctl set global disable_canary_flags=true --reason "kms-decrypt-errors"`.

ops-bot: Executing command. Global flag `disable_canary_flags` set to true.

maya (oncall): ops-bot - thanks. Notifying customers: product?

leah (eng-runtime): quick telemetry: request failures for /flags returned 500s for ~18% of canary users over last 4 minutes. Fallback behavior returns default OFF for new flags. Impact window approx 4-8 minutes, ~20k requests. No user data exposed.

olga (infra): Grant created: `grantId` = 5e1a2b3c. Applied to key 9a8b7c6d.

leah (eng-runtime): reloading key cache in connectors... pods retrying decrypt...

leah (eng-runtime): logs now show successful decrypt on 11/15 canary pods:
```
2026-03-15T14:28:12Z INFO kms_client.go:45 decrypt ok for key 9a8b7c6d
```
Remaining 4 pods are in CrashLoopBackOff due to startup timeout while waiting for dependency; restarting them now.

deploy-bot: Rolling update: restarting 4 failed pods for deployment ff-bridge (canary subset).

ryo (eng-sre): Watch CPU and restart storms. If remaining pods don't come up within 5m, plan is to rollback to prior stable release tag c4b2a.

maya (oncall): Handoff: I need to step out. Handoff to ryo. Notes: root cause is KMS rotation + missing grant to canary-role created overnight; mitigation steps taken: created grant, set global disable flag, restarted pods. Monitor until stable. Escalation timer 14:40Z.

ryo (eng-sre): Taking over. Setting incident timer.

leah (eng-runtime): All 15 canary pods now pass KMS decrypt and healthchecks. Error rate back to baseline (<0.5%). Turning off global override in 2 minutes to ensure flags evaluate normally.

ops-bot: Scheduled command `ffctl unset global disable_canary_flags` in 2 minutes.

ryo (eng-sre): Good. Confirming post-mortem actions: 1) Add a deploy-time KMS grant validation that verifies grants/grantee principals exist for rotated keys (leah + ryo), 2) add infra automation to automatically grant rotated keys to known deploy principals (olga), 3) update rotation runbook to include canary-role in grant step (olga), 4) add CI check to fail deploy if recent key rotation detected and grants not present (ryo).

leah (eng-runtime): I'll open the PR for pre-deploy KMS checks and link to logs: https://internal.logs/redwood/incident/1912356789

olga (infra): I'll add automation to rotation tooling to include `role/canary-role`, and add a test that creates a dummy grant and validates decrypt from a canary-like principal.

ryo (eng-sre): Incident status: mitigated. Monitoring for 10 more minutes. Severity lowered to SEV-2.

maya (oncall): leaving these as follow-ups assigned. I'll draft a short customer note and pass to product for review.

ops-bot: Incident marked MITIGATED by ryo at 2026-03-15T14:36:40Z.

maya (oncall): Thanks all. Follow-ups tracked: RH-3499 (automation for grants), RH-3500 (pre-deploy KMS check), RH-3501 (rotation runbook update), RH-3502 (postmortem write-up). Closing handoff thread. :thumbsup:
